name: whispermix-transcribe
description: Transcribe audio files locally with WhisperMix using a persistent daemon that keeps the model warm.

MODEL.prompt: Local WhisperMix model id, for example efederici/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int4.

LANGUAGE.prompt: Language hint for local Whisper models, for example spanish or auto.

IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.prompt: How long the daemon should stay alive while idle.
